Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation Limited, Shakti Bhawan, 14, Ashok Marg, Lucknow-226001, Uttar Pradesh. ** Respondent** ## ** ORDER ** Teestavalley Power Transmission Limited has filed the instant petition for approval to establish Transmission Line Stores along with associated infrastructure for the 400 kV Order in Petition No. 226/MP/2023 Page **2** of **3** D/C Teesta-III-Kishanganj Transmission Line of Teestavalley Power Transmission Limited. 2. The Petitioner has made the following prayers in the instant petition: - _“A. Admit the Petition and grant approval to the Petitioner for establishment of Transmission Line Stores along with associated infrastructure as proposed in the petition hereinabove;_ - _B. Permit the Petitioner to claim the additional capitalization incurred for the establishment of Transmission Line Stores along with associated infrastructure on actual basis in the truing up exercise;_ - _C. Pass such other relief as Hon'ble Commission deems fit and appropriate under the circumstances of the case and in the interest of justice.”_ 3. The Petitioner, vide affidavit dated 8.5.2024, has prayed to allow to withdraw the instant petition with a liberty to file a fresh petition in terms of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2024 and for waiver/ adjustment of court fee for filing of fresh petition. 4. We hereby allow the Petitioner to withdraw the petition, with a liberty to file a fresh petition in accordance with law. The filing fee paid by the Petitioner in the instant petition will be adjusted towards the fee to be paid by the Petitioner in any future petition. 5. Accordingly, Petition No. 226/MP/2023 is disposed of as withdrawn. **sd/- sd/(P. K. Singh) Member** **(Jishnu Barua) Chairperson** CERC Website S.
